en.baptism: In the year one thousand eight hundred and seventy-one, on the 1st day of August, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the local priest Fr. Jacewicz baptised a child named Konstantyn with all the rites of the Sacrament.

en.godparents: The godparents were Maciej Chesnovskii and Petronela Ionunnevna, a maiden.
en.side:
Narkevich
No. 190, boy, born 30, baptised 1
Later note: Konstantinas Narkevičius received the sacrament of marriage in Kantaučiai church on 8 February 1927, marrying Teresė Zobramytė.

issues.lt: Gimimo metai perskaityti 1841; kaimo pavadinimas neaiškus (gal Merkelių); motinos ir krikštamotės pavardės neaiškios.
